mapper.select: SELECT user_info.headimg_url headimgUrl, user_info.nick_name nickName, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - order_info.payment_time)) / 3600) || '小时前' AS timeAgo FROM order_info order_info INNER JOIN user_info user_info ON order_info.user_id = user_info.id WHERE order_info.payment_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY order_info.payment_time DESC LIMIT 10
